info.name: Event Ticket Booking & Management Platform
info.description:
Full API collection for the Event Ticket Booking & Management Platform. Covers all 44 endpoints from docs/requirements.md.

HOW TO USE:
1. Import this collection AND make sure your API is running (`npm run dev`) with `npm run seed` already applied.
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if your server isn't on the default http://localhost:5000/api/v1.
3. Run folders 01 through 11 in order (top to bottom) -- either manually or via Collection Runner -- for a complete happy-path walkthrough. Each request's Tests tab automatically captures IDs/tokens it returns (accessToken, eventId, ticketTierId, bookingId, paymentId, etc.) into collection variables, so nothing needs to be copy-pasted by hand.
4. Folder 12 contains destructive/role-changing requests (cancel, suspend, role change, delete) -- run these last, and only if you want to exercise those flows.

NOTE: 'Mock Confirm Payment' in folder 07 only works when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is left blank in your .env (the default for local dev) -- it simulates a successful payment webhook so you can exercise the full booking lifecycle without real Stripe credentials.
